WATCHER-MIRACLE.title: Miracle
WATCHER-INSIGHT.title: Insight
WATCHER-SMITE.title: Smite
WATCHER-SMITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Divine[/gold]: The target loses {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
WATCHER-EVALUATE.title: Evaluate
WATCHER-EVALUATE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
{IfUpgraded:show:Add an |Shuffle an }[gold]Insight[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: to the top of| into} your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
WATCHER-FLYING_SLEEVES.title: Flying Sleeves
WATCHER-PROSTRATE.title: Prostrate
WATCHER-PROSTRATE.description:
Gain {MantraPower:diff()} [gold]Mantra[/gold].
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Block is increased by half the [gold]Mantra[/gold] gained this combat.
WATCHER-WREATH_OF_FLAME.title: Wreath of Flame
WATCHERREBALANCE-HEROIC_STRIKE.title: Heroic Strike
WATCHERREBALANCE-HEROIC_STRIKE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Miracle[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-PATH_TO_VICTORY.title: Path to Victory
WATCHERREBALANCE-PATH_TO_VICTORY.descrip:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Scry[/gold] 2.
|}Draw a card.
It is free to play this turn.
WATCHER-BATTLE_HYMN.title: Battle Hymn
WATCHER-BATTLE_HYMN.description: Whenever you change Stances, add a [gold]Smite[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-CARVE_REALITY.title: Carve Reality
WATCHER-CARVE_REALITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Smite[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Divine[/gold]: Add [gold]Replay[/gold] to a [gold]Token[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-DECEIVE_REALITY.title: Deceive Reality
WATCHER-FEAR_NO_EVIL.title: Fear No Evil
WATCHER-FEAR_NO_EVIL.description:
If the enemy intends to attack, enter [gold]Calm[/gold] and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Otherwise, enter [gold]Wrath[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
WATCHER-EMPTY_BODY.title: Empty Body
WATCHER-EMPTY_BODY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you are in a Stance, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Exit your Stance.
WATCHER-EMPTY_FIST.title: Empty Fist
WATCHER-EMPTY_FIST.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you are in a Stance, gain 
1 [gold]Strength[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:.| this turn.}
Exit your Stance.
WATCHER-EMPTY_MIND.title: Empty Mind
WATCHER-EMPTY_MIND.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
If you are in a Stance, shuffle {IfUpgraded:show:{Insights:diff()} [gold]Insights[/gold]|an [gold]Insight[/gold]} into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Exit your Stance.
WATCHER-LIKE_WATER.title: Like Water
WATCHER-MENTAL_FORTRESS.title: Mental Fortress
WATCHER-MENTAL_FORTRESS.description: At the start of your turn, choose a [gold]Token[/gold] card from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and add it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-MENTAL_FORTRESS.selectionScreenP: Choose [gold]Token[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-PRAY.title: Pray
WATCHER-PRAY.description:
Gain {MantraPower:diff()} [gold]Mantra[/gold].
Shuffle an [gold]Insight[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] for every {IfUpgraded:show:2|3} [gold]Mantra[/gold] you have.
WATCHER-REACH_HEAVEN.title: Reach Heaven
WATCHER-REACH_HEAVEN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Through Violence[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
[gold]Divine[/gold]: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
WATCHER-SIGNATURE_MOVE.title: Signature Move
WATCHER-SIGNATURE_MOVE.description:
Can only be played if all Attacks in your [gold]Hand[/gold] are [gold]Signature Move[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
WATCHER-SIMMERING_FURY.title: Simmering Fury
WATCHER-SIMMERING_FURY.description:
At the start of your next turn, enter [gold]Wrath[/gold] and draw 3 cards.{IfUpgraded:show:
[gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.|}
WATCHER-STUDY.title: Study
WATCHER-STUDY.description: Whenever you change Stances, shuffle an [gold]Insight[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
WATCHER-TALK_TO_THE_HAND.title: Talk to the Hand
WATCHER-TALK_TO_THE_HAND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever this enemy is attacked, the attacker gains {BlockReturnPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
WATCHER-WORSHIP.title: Worship
WATCHER-WORSHIP.description:
Gain 5 [gold]Mantra[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
If you enter [gold]Divinity[/gold] this turn, choose a [gold]Smite[/gold], [gold]Miracle[/gold], or [gold]Insight[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].|}
WATCHER-COLLECT.title: Collect
WATCHER-COLLECT.description:
Put a [gold]Miracle[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of your next {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} turns.
If X is {ReplayThreshold:diff()} or more, add [gold]Replay[/gold] to them.
WATCHERREBALANCE-REVERE.title: Revere
WATCHERREBALANCE-WARD.title: Ward
WATCHERREBALANCE-WARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Scry[/gold], return this from the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-ALPHA.title: Alpha
WATCHER-ALPHA.description:
Shuffle a [gold]Beta[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
WATCHER-BETA.title: Beta
WATCHER-BETA.description:
Shuffle an [gold]Omega[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
WATCHER-OMEGA.title: Omega
WATCHER-OMEGA.description: At the end of your turn, deal {OmegaPower:diff()}×X damage to ALL enemies.
WATCHER-BLASPHEMY.title: Blasphemy
WATCHER-BLASPHEMY.description:
Gain {MantraPower:diff()} [gold]Mantra[/gold].
You cannot gain any more [gold]Mantra[/gold] this combat.
WATCHERREBALANCE-UNWORTHY.title: Unworthy
WATCHERREBALANCE-TRAITOR.title: Traitor
WATCHERREBALANCE-REPENT.title: Repent
WATCHERREBALANCE-FORSAKEN.title: Forsaken
WATCHERREBALANCE-HERETIC.title: Heretic
WATCHERREBALANCE-APOSTATE.title: Apostate
WATCHERREBALANCE-APOSTATE.description:
[color=#76C8FF][i]You left the [/i][/color][gold]Path[/gold][color=#FF7E61][i].[/i][/color]
[color=#CE72FF][i]The Path did not [/i][/color][color=#7DFF98][i]leave you.[/i][/color]
WATCHERREBALANCE-PROFANE.title: Profane
WATCHERREBALANCE-CONDEMNED.title: Condemned
WATCHERREBALANCE-UNFORGIVEN.title: Unforgiven
WATCHERREBALANCE-JUDGEMENT.title: Judgement
WATCHER-BRILLIANCE.title: Brilliance
WATCHER-BRILLIANCE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Deals additional damage equal to [gold]Mantra[/gold] gained this combat.
WATCHER-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.title: Deus Ex Machina
WATCHER-DEUS_EX_MACHINA.description:
When drawn, play this card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Miracles[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-DEVA_FORM.title: Deva Form
WATCHER-DEVA_FORM.description:
When you enter [gold]Calm[/gold],
 gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
When you enter [gold]Wrath[/gold],
 gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
When you enter [gold]Divinity[/gold],
 gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
WATCHER-DEVOTION.title: Devotion
WATCHER-DEVOTION.description: Whenever you change Stances, add a [gold]Miracle[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHER-LESSON_LEARNED.title: Lesson Learned
WATCHER-LESSON_LEARNED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
WATCHER-RAGNAROK.title: Ragnarok
WATCHER-RAGNAROK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to {IfUpgraded:show:ALL enemies|a random enemy} 5 times.
WATCHER-SPIRIT_SHIELD.title: Spirit Shield
WATCHERREBALANCE-CHOREOGRAPH.title: Choreograph
WATCHERREBALANCE-CHOREOGRAPH.description:
Put {Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] them and give them [gold]Retain[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-CHOREOGRAPH.selectionSc: Choose cards to return to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-CONDEMN.title: Condemn
WATCHERREBALANCE-CONDEMN.description:
[gold]Divine[/gold]: Set the target's HP to 0 unless it is an Elite or Boss.
Otherwise, deal {Damage:diff()} damage 3 times.
WATCHERREBALANCE-DIVINE_INTERVENTION.des:
[gold]Divine[/gold]: [gold]Replay[/gold] {Replay:diff()}.
Choose one: [gold]Wealth Beyond Measure[/gold], [gold]Attain Perfection[/gold], or [gold]Claim Your Destiny[/gold].
End your turn.
WATCHERREBALANCE-ATTAIN_PERFECTION.title: Attain Perfection
WATCHERREBALANCE-ATTAIN_PERFECTION.descr:
[gold]Enchant[/gold] a random eligible card in your Deck.
Attacks gain [purple]Sharp[/purple]. Skills gain [purple]Nimble[/purple]. Powers gain [purple]Swift[/purple].
WATCHERREBALANCE-EBB_AND_FLOW.title: Ebb and Flow
WATCHERREBALANCE-EBB_AND_FLOW.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The first time you play this card each turn enter [gold]Calm[/gold].
When you switch Stances, return this from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-FORESHADOW.title: Foreshadow
WATCHERREBALANCE-FORESHADOW.description:
The first {IfUpgraded:show:2 |}{Cards:plural:card|cards} you play next turn {Cards:plural:is|are} played an additional time.
End your turn.
WATCHERREBALANCE-OMNIPOTENCE.title: Omnipotence
WATCHERREBALANCE-OMNIPOTENCE.description:
Draw X cards.
Gain X*2 [gold]Mantra[/gold].
Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold].
WATCHER-ANCIENT_CARD2.title: Revelation
WATCHER-ANCIENT_CARD.title: Rushdown
WATCHER-SHARED_WISDOM.title: Shared Ascension
WATCHER-SHARED_WISDOM.description:
Another player enters [gold]Divinity[/gold].
If you are in [gold]Divinity[/gold], all players enter [gold]Divinity[/gold].
WATCHER-FLEETING_CLARITY.title: Fleeting Clarity
WATCHER-FLEETING_CLARITY.description:
Another player enters [gold]Calm[/gold].
If you are in [gold]Calm[/gold], all other players enter [gold]Calm[/gold].
At the start of the next turn they exit [gold]Calm[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-MANIPULATE_REALITY.desc: All players [gold]Scry[/gold] {Scry:diff()} and draw a card.
WATCHERREBALANCE-ONSLAUGHT.title: Onslaught
WATCHERREBALANCE-ONSLAUGHT.description: Another player enters [gold]Wrath[/gold]. If you are in [gold]Wrath[/gold], all other players enter [gold]Wrath[/gold]. At the start of the next turn they exit [gold]Wrath[/gold].
WATCHERREBALANCE-OMNIPRESENCE.title: Omnipresence
WATCHERREBALANCE-OMNIPRESENCE.descriptio: All players gain a [gold]Miracle[/gold], [gold]Smite[/gold], and [gold]Insight[/gold] into their Hand.
